documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Sportking India reported strong performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by healthy export and domestic demand, stable raw material costs, and enhanced operational efficiencies. Management noted that the 150,000 spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing on schedule with commercial production expected to commence within the next 30 to 40 days. The company remains optimistic about medium to long-term industry outlooks, supported by favorable government incentives in Odisha and growing global textile sourcing shifts toward India. Furthermore, management expects current margin trends and spreads to be sustainable for the upcoming quarters. Sportking India Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting a revenue from operations of Rs.

guidance.claim: Management expects the new Odisha project to contribute around INR150 crores to INR200 crores in revenue for the remaining part of the current financial year.
guidance.quote: So we expect a contribution of around INR150 crores to INR200 crores coming off the capacity in the time left in this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates revenue of around INR1,200 crores to INR1,300 crores from the Odisha project in the next financial year.
guidance.quote: And we expect a revenue of around INR1,200 to INR1,300 crores in next financial year and about INR150 to INR200 crores in this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management guides that margins in the Odisha unit will be 4% to 5% or maybe 6% higher than the rest of the operations once it is operational.
guidance.quote: So, our margins in Odisha unit will be at least 4% to 5%, or maybe 6% more than whatever we achieve once it is operational.

guidance.claim: Management expects the depreciation run rate to be around INR17 crores from next quarter.
guidance.quote: So from next quarter, we expect the run rate to be around INR17 crores – vis-à-vis INR24 in last quarter and INR14 in this quarter.

guidance.claim: The company expects its top line to reach approximately INR3,000 crores for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: So this year, last year, our top line was around INR2,500 crores. So this year, we are expecting somewhere around INR3,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue to exceed INR4,000 crores next year with the new plant.
guidance.quote: And next year, with the new plant, we see this going up to around more than INR4,000 crores.

guidance.claim: The company provides a long-term EBITDA margin guidance of 15% once the new project is operational.
guidance.quote: So we give a long-term guidance of once a new project comes in a guidance of 15%, and we'll stick to that.

guidance.claim: Management expects the contribution of value-added products like fabrics and garments to reach around 10% in the next one year.
guidance.quote: But in next 1 year, we would say around 10%.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates the newly acquired downstream businesses to contribute 8% to 10% to the top line from next year.
guidance.quote: we expect these businesses to start contributing to the tune of 8% to 10% to our top line and anywhere close to the similar kind of EBITDA what we have in our bottom line from next year.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from export markets like China and Bangladesh continues to be robust.
demand_outlook.quote: So the demand from China and Bangladesh continue to be robust and the Indian market was a little bit slow in last 2 months, 3 months, but with this festival season approaching and the spring production commencing after Diwali, which is traditionally the peak season for the domestic market.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has visibility for yarn demand till 10 March, and it is pretty good.
demand_outlook.quote: So right now we have a visibility for the next till 10 March and it is pretty good. The demand is the same or even better than what it was.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports constituted about 52% of total revenue in the last quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: So it is about 52% of our total revenue the last quarter has been through exports.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that demand from all markets remained healthy with a supportive outlook going into the second quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from all the markets continued to remain healthy, and we are also encouraged by the outlook going into the second quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: On the domestic front, the company expects demand to remain supportive in coming quarters aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.
demand_outlook.quote: On the domestic front, we expect demand to remain supportive in the coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.

demand_outlook.claim: The company observed that incremental demand for Indian yarn exports has primarily come from China due to higher domestic cotton prices in China.
demand_outlook.quote: So most of the incremental demand, which has come into India for yarn export is from China.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000 spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing on schedule and building construction is almost complete.
capex_expansion.quote: On the strategic front are 150,000 spindle Greenfield expansion project in Odisha continues to progress on schedule. Having secured all necessary regulatory approvals, the building construction is now almost complete.

capex_expansion.claim: The entire machinery package for the Odisha project has been ordered and is arriving at the site in a staggered manner.
capex_expansion.quote: The entire machinery package has been ordered and has started arriving on the site in a staggered manner.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production at the Odisha greenfield project is intended to start within the next 30 to 40 days.
capex_expansion.quote: Like, our Greenfield project to come in 8 months is a big achievement for us and we intend to start commercial production within next 30 days, 40 days.

capex_expansion.claim: The Odisha project includes a 30% capital subsidy payable in 5 equal installments, translating to about INR200 to INR220 crores coming back over 5 years on a INR1,000 crores investment.
capex_expansion.quote: First is the capital subsidy, which we are going to get for 30% capital subsidy, which will be paid to us in 5 equal installments. On a INR1,000 crores investment, we are looking at about INR200 to INR220 crores coming back to us in 5 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Power in Odisha will be provided at INR4 per unit for 10 years as part of the state incentives.
capex_expansion.quote: We are going to get power at INR4 for 10 years in Odisha.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations.
capex_expansion.quote: I'm pleased to share that our solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing as planned with construction currently underway.
capex_expansion.quote: Our 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is also progressing as planned. We are very excited with that. Construction activities is underway

capex_expansion.claim: The total announced capex for the Odisha greenfield project is approximately INR975 crores to INR1,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So ma'am, right now, what we have announced is about INR1000 crores, INR975 crores and which will be completed by the end of this financial year.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 15%.
margins_costs.quote: Beyond supporting our environmental goals, the project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Management considers the first-half margins to be sustainable for the second half of the year on old capacity.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, I definitely think that what margins we have made in the first half are sustainable and I'm talking about our old capacity.

margins_costs.claim: Yarn spreads in Q2 were around INR141 per kg compared to INR133 in Q1.
margins_costs.quote: No, Q1 was around INR133 and Q2 has been around INR141.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power plant is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.
margins_costs.quote: Commenced commercial operations of power supply on 18th June 2026 and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

margins_costs.claim: Strategic buying enabled the company to effectively manage input costs and protect margins despite rising raw material prices.
margins_costs.quote: Despite some increases in raw material prices during this period, our strategic buying approach enabled us to effectively manage input costs and protect margins.

margins_costs.claim: The annual cost savings from the solar project are quantified at around INR15 crores.
margins_costs.quote: It should be around INR15 crores with this solar park, yes.

margins_costs.claim: The overall product spread during the quarter was INR133 per kg compared to INR107 in the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So the overall spread was INR133 vis-a-vis INR107 last quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Margins from the Odisha plant are expected to be at least 300 to 400 basis points higher than older plants due to embedded incentives.
margins_costs.quote: So we expect the margins coming out of that plant to be at least 300 to 400 basis points or even more than what we do in our old plants.

orders_capacity.claim: Existing facilities operated at 99% capacity during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: as the company is already cranking up at 99% capacity this quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization of all units is more than 96%.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilisation of all units more than 96%

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains an order book ranging between 70 to 90 days as part of its risk management policy.
orders_capacity.quote: We have an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days in any year, whether it is this year or even the last year or whichever year because this is our policy we work to manage our risk of having higher inventory.

capital_allocation.claim: The mode of payment for merging the fabric and garment companies is going to be through non-convertible preferential share allotment along with a minor cash transaction not exceeding INR25 crores to INR30 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, I think this has been all because that we are -- the mode of payment is going to be the preferential share allotment, which will be non-convertible. Yeah. So, there will be some preferential share, and very minor cash transaction, not exceeding INR25 crores to INR30 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, along with the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, along with the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis, subject to the completion and execution of definitive agreements.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to complete the Odisha greenfield project by the end of the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: and we intend to complete the project by March '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to start commercial production at the Odisha plant within the next 30 to 40 days.
management_commitments.quote: and we intend to start commercial production within next 30 days, 40 days.

management_commitments.claim: The proposed capex programme is to take 12-15 months to complete.
management_commitments.quote: # Proposed capex programme to tak 12-15 months to complete

management_commitments.claim: The first phase of production for the Odisha project is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to finish the entire Odisha expansion project within the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects it to take around 5 to 6 months to fully ramp up the Odisha plant after commissioning next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: And we expect to ramp up the whole plant. It's a big plant. So it will take us around 5 to 6 months to fully ramp up.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the Odisha plant to reach about 90% capacity utilization by the end of March.
management_commitments.quote: And I think by March end, we should be at about 90% capacity utilization for the whole plant.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to start seeing a moderation in cotton prices by October due to the early arrival of the new crop.
management_commitments.quote: So we expect by October, we shall start seeing moderation in cotton prices because right now, these prices are just because there's not much crop left.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
